lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are organized in longitudinal tracks along the lateral surface, primarily posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs concentrated near the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) are visible in the ventral-posterior field of view near the pelvic fins.
